site.title: Hlola le sayithi
site.text: Lokho inqubomgomo yale sayithi enakho le nguqulo engakufundi, noma ekufunda ngenye indlela, amakheli ewabizayo, nendlela iseva ethumela ngayo ifayela ngalinye. Akukho okuphuma kulesi siphequluli ngaphandle, uma ucela, kwesicelo kulelo nalelo kheli.
site.unnamed: I-index.html ayibizi nqubomgomo: lena inguqulo evulekile, engenalutho olusethwe yinhlangano.
site.chosen: Ifayela {file}, elikhethwe lapha, lihlolwe ngokuqhathaniswa nale sayithi.
site.fine: Yonke ingxenye ifundwa yile nguqulo, ngesimo eyifunda ngaso.
site.object: Kufanele kube yiqembu lezilungiselelo, phakathi kuka-{ }.
site.https: Akulona ikheli le-https: iziphequluli zenqaba i-http elula, ngaphandle kwale khompyutha.
site.unreached: Ayikho impendulo le sayithi engayifunda: kuphansi, akufinyeleleki ukusuka lapha, noma akuyivumeli le sayithi (CORS).
site.key: Ukhiye uvula le nguqulo lapha enhlanganweni {organisation}, kuze kube {date}.
site.trial: Ukhiye wokuzama uvula le nguqulo lapha enhlanganweni {organisation}, kuze kube {date}.
